lead.event: IDX places 383 stocks on the High Shareholding Concentration list and adjusts IHSG weights
lead.headline: IDX places 383 stocks on HSC list and adjusts IHSG weights
lead.blurb: In its incidental IHSG evaluation alongside the HSC designation, IDX gave BCA the largest weight at 10.38%, followed by BRI at 9.95%, Bank Mandiri at 7.82%, Astra at 5.49% and Telkom at 4.92%. Stocks qualify for HSC when 10 or fewer shareholders hold at least 92.5% of their shares, and gradual IHSG exclusions took effect on 13 November. IDX's next scheduled review is in January 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: ICBP raises noodle prices and updates 2026 revenue growth guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: ICBP raises noodle prices about 3%, lifts 2026 revenue growth guidance to 12%-14%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indofood CBP raised domestic prices in mid-October as higher raw-material and packaging costs narrowed nine-month gross margin to 34.1%. It maintained its EBIT margin target of 20%-22% and capped advertising and promotion spending at 4% of sales.

earnings_guidance.event: BRMS returns to net profit in Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: BRMS returns to net profit in Q3 2026 with US$11 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi Resources Minerals’ revenue rose 172.8% quarter on quarter to US$71.8 million as gold sales recovered to 16,748 troy ounces and ore grade improved to 1.94 grams per ton. Samuel Sekuritas maintained its buy recommendation, while the company plans to raise processing capacity from 500 to 2,000 tons per day in early 2027.

deals_control.event: INPP sells its entire stake in subsidiary PT Indonesia Gemilang Mahasentosa
deals_control.headline: INPP sells its entire IGM stake for Rp185.7 billion
deals_control.blurb: Indonesian Paradise Property transferred 445.6 million shares, representing 99.99999978% of Indonesia Gemilang Mahasentosa, to Prospek Duta Sukses on 12 November. Prospek Duta Sukses and Praba Kumala Sajati are now the subsidiary’s sole shareholders.

deals_control.event: GDK increases its stake in DGIK
deals_control.headline: GDK raises its DGIK stake by 14.02%
deals_control.blurb: Nusa Konstruksi’s controlling shareholder GDK bought 777.47 million shares for about Rp107.8 billion from 9 to 12 November at Rp135 and Rp150 per share, lifting its holding to 68.20% from 54.24%. Nusa Konstruksi also plans to transfer up to 400.21 million treasury shares to GDK, amid plans for Tokyu Construction to enter.
